caption: The drawing shows a two-piece suit consisting of a jacket and knee-length breeches, both rendered in shades of gray with a fine crosshatch pattern representing the fabric. The jacket has long sleeves, a rounded collar, and an open front, with black decorative trim outlining the collar, front edges, cuffs, and bottom hem in a looping pattern. The breeches are high-waisted and extend to just below the knees, featuring the same checked pattern and matching decorative black trim along the outer seams, bottom hems, and waistband in a swirling motif. A white shirt with visible buttons is partially visible beneath the open jacket. The overall composition presents the suit in a three-quarter view with no visible wearer and a neutral background.
title: Boy's Suit
